method: Five family-disjoint folds; dev families each have unit training weight, retaining the planted clone-type population weights; dev unknowns excluded. Dev IDF is precomputed from each real source snapshot, without label information. Planted IDF is training-fold-only. Lowest OOF threshold >= preexisting confidence floor reaching >=95% BOTH combined and planted BLOCK precision. No reserved histories consulted. A prior all-family-unit fit was rejected before replay for 8.2% planted recall despite 100% precision.
